#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline SIP identity boundary processor.

Implements the deterministic batch protocol described in PROTOCOL.md
(revision 1): parse and validate untrusted SIP request text, resolve
identity claims strictly through the supplied directory, apply the
ingress authorization policy of the receiving gateway, and emit the
canonical forwarded wire text for accepted requests.

Standard library only.  Reads one JSON object on stdin, writes one JSON
object on stdout.
"""

import json
import re
import sys

# Protocol constants
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

ANON = "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"
MAX_TEXT = 32768
MAX_PHYS_LINES = 512
MAX_LOGICAL_FIELDS = 128
CSEQ_MAX = 2147483647

METHODS = ("INVITE", "MESSAGE")

_LETTERS = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
_DIGITS = "0123456789"

ALNUM = frozenset(_LETTERS + _DIGITS)
TOKEN_CHARS = frozenset(_LETTERS + _DIGITS + "-.!%*_+`'~")
USER_CHARS = frozenset(_LETTERS + _DIGITS + "-_.!~*'()+")
HEXDIG = frozenset(_DIGITS + "ABCDEFabcdef")
WS = " \t"
# Characters that terminate a URI token inside a header value.
URI_STOP = frozenset(" \t<>,;")

CALLID_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.@+-]{1,128}\Z")
HEADER_RE = re.compile(r"([-A-Za-z0-9.!%*_+`'~]+)[ \t]*:(.*)\Z")

COMPACT = {
    "f": "from",
    "t": "to",
    "i": "call-id",
    "l": "content-length",
    "c": "content-type",
}

REQUIRED = ("from", "to", "call-id", "cseq", "content-length")
SINGLETON = ("p-preferred-identity", "remote-party-id", "privacy", "content-type")


class Reject(Exception):
    """A deterministic protocol rejection."""

    __slots__ = ("reason",)

    def __init__(self, reason):
        Exception.__init__(self, reason)
        self.reason = reason


def syntax():
    raise Reject("syntax")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Character level helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def check_head_chars(line):
    """Header section lines: printable ASCII plus HTAB only."""
    for ch in line:
        o = ord(ch)
        if o != 9 and not (32 <= o <= 126):
            syntax()


def check_body_chars(body):
    """Body: printable ASCII, HTAB, CR and LF only."""
    for ch in body:
        o = ord(ch)
        if o == 9 or o == 10 or o == 13:
            continue
        if not (32 <= o <= 126):
            syntax()


def skip_ws(value, index):
    n = len(value)
    while index < n and value[index] in WS:
        index += 1
    return index


def strip_ws(value):
    return value.strip(" \t")
